Today a very simple home style dish!
*********
METHI PANEER
Preparation time: 10 minutes
Serves: 2
Ingredients:
1 bunch, methi leaves, cleaned, (washed twice)
1 inches ginger, grated
2-3 garlic pods, roughly chopped
For Methi Paneer
1 tbsp Ghee
¼ tsp cumin seeds
2-3 small onion, chopped
1 medium Tomatoes, chopped
½ tsp Turmeric powder
250-300 gm Paneer, cut into cubes
1/2 tbsp. kasoori methi
½ ltr milk
Salt as per taste
Garnish
Ginger, julienne
Process
• Heat ghee in a kadai and add cumin seeds. Stir for a
minute until fragrant.
• Now add onion, ginger and garlic, saute until they turn
golden brown. Add tomatoes and cook till soft.
• Add methi leaves, turmeric, kasoori methi, milk and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
• Transfer paneer cubes and cook for another a minute.
• Garnish with ginger julienne.
